style_prompt: Generate a black and white tarot card illustration, bold clean vector line art in a humorous gothic style: {SCENE}. Ornate decorative frame with a double-rule border and corner rose motifs, scattered stars and sparkles in the background, high contrast pure black ink on plain white background, no grayscale, no shading, no gradients, thick sticker-style outlines, whimsical sarcastic mood, centered composition, tall portrait orientation. Important: absolutely no text, no lettering, no numbers, no words anywhere in the image.
